title: Signature: Expiry and renewal tracker
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): time-limited data grants carry expiry dates, and the tracker warns before expiry and revokes after. Expired grants stop authorizing use automatically. Renewals create new ledger entries; nothing extends silently. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers expiry dates on time-limited grants.
kind: data license and usage rights checker
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 60, 2: 10, 3: -5}
days_left = CFG[LEVEL]
status = "valid" if days_left > 30 else ("expiring soon" if days_left > 0 else "EXPIRED: use revoked")
print("grant expires in %d days ->" % days_left, status)
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Consent-chain verification
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): for data requiring subject consent, the consent chain is verified end to end: collection consent, processing consent, and sharing consent, each with scope and timestamp. Broken chains block use. Consent is re-verified, not assumed perpetual. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers collection, processing, sharing consent links.
kind: data license and usage rights checker
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: [True, True, True], 2: [True, False, True], 3: [True, True, False]}
links = ["collection", "processing", "sharing"]
chain = dict(zip(links, CFG[LEVEL]))
ok = all(chain.values())
print("consent chain:", chain, "| use:", "ALLOWED" if ok else "BLOCKED: broken consent chain")
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Safe-harbor defaults
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): when rights are unknown, the system defaults to the safest posture: all-rights-reserved, no redistribution, internal use only. Safe harbors are explicit and logged, so caution is visible rather than silent. Unknown never means unrestricted. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers all-rights-reserved default for unknown rights.
kind: data license and usage rights checker
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: "MIT", 2: None, 3: "custom-unknown"}
lic = CFG[LEVEL]
posture = "per license terms" if lic in ("MIT", "Apache-2.0") else "SAFE HARBOR: internal only, no redistribution"
print("license:", lic, "->", posture)
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.
